title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 2, part 1: James Monroe
summary: "A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 2, part 1" compiled by James D. Richardson is a historical compilation copyrighted in 1897. This volume preserves the official proclamations, special messages, and inauguration speeches of American presidents.
